inspiration: Hotkeys as named, rebindable actions with one editor page (README.md line 11). Pattern: every action has a name, a default and a rebind screen.
Undo and redo as a shared command framework (README.md line 10). Pattern: every edit is a reversible command, which suits zone-data editing.
Transform handles drawn on the selected object via ImGuizmo (README.md line 7). Pattern: direct manipulation of a placed object in the scene.
Free-look camera that hides the avatar only while detached (README.md line 18). Pattern: an inspection camera separate from the play camera.
Offline scene mode (README.md line 15). Pattern: authoring without the live server, which suits zone authoring.
Small flat one-glyph icons for each command (data/Icons). Pattern: readable at 375 wide; pixel sizes not measured.

briefs.label: on-object move handles
briefs.why: a placed object is edited where it sits, with handles on the selection
briefs.keep: one handle set per selected object; drag to move; every drag is undoable
briefs.change: our own handle shapes (rings and pillars) in our palette, not default axis colours

briefs.label: remap-everything page
briefs.why: every action is a named binding on one page
briefs.keep: named actions with rebind and reset
briefs.change: touch first: long-press an action to rebind; preset layouts for thumb play

briefs.label: detached inspection camera
briefs.why: free look that hides the avatar only while the camera is detached
briefs.keep: avatar hidden only in this mode; the play camera returns on exit
briefs.change: our version is a slow replay dolly for the fight record, not free fly

briefs.label: edit history for zone data
briefs.why: every edit is a reversible command
briefs.keep: a command stack with undo and redo
briefs.change: each command is a zone-data diff shown as a preview before it applies

cross_link: Camera: free-look idea (README line 18) is worth a look for the replay camera. HUD/UI: flat icons and an editor UI, worth a look for the editor only. Sound, music, zones, spawns, loot, VFX and animation: nothing in this donor.
